scripts.build:native: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=MinSizeRel && cmake --build build --target blendx_hermes hermesc -j
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:types
scripts.example: npm run build:native && node tools/hermes-app.mjs run examples/counter.tsx --
scripts.stress: npm run build:native && node tools/hermes-app.mjs run examples/stress.tsx --
scripts.chat: npm run build:native && node tools/hermes-app.mjs run examples/chat.tsx --
scripts.chat:benchmark: npm run build:native && node tools/hermes-app.mjs run examples/chat.tsx -- --headless
scripts.benchmark: npm run build:native && node tools/hermes-app.mjs run examples/stress.tsx -- --headless
scripts.compile:chat: npm run build:native && node tools/hermes-app.mjs pack examples/chat.tsx build/blendx-chat
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test-addon && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
